# 🛡️ Anubis Security Tool — Code of Conduct

We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming community for everyone contributing to **Anubis Security Tool**.

## 🤝 Our Standards

- 💬 **Be Respectful:** Treat everyone with kindness and professionalism. Harassment, discrimination, and personal attacks are not tolerated.
- 🧠 **Collaborate Constructively:** Focus on ideas, technical decisions, and solutions — not personal criticism.
- 🌱 **Support Others:** Welcome newcomers, share knowledge, and respect different backgrounds and perspectives.
- 🔍 **Report Responsibly:** Report bugs and non-sensitive issues through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Anubis-Security-Tool/anubis/issues). Report security vulnerabilities privately using the repository's security reporting channels.
- 🔒 **Respect Privacy:** Do not publish private information, credentials, or sensitive data without permission.
- ⚖️ **Act in Good Faith:** Contribute honestly, respect project guidelines, and help maintain a safe environment for everyone.

## 🚫 Unacceptable Behavior

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, threats, deliberate intimidation, publishing private information, and other conduct that creates a hostile environment.

## 📣 Reporting Concerns

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, contact the project maintainers privately at **admin@anubis.locker**.

Security vulnerabilities should be reported privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/Anubis-Security-Tool/anubis/security/advisories/new), rather than posted publicly.

## 🌍 Our Commitment

We aim to foster an open, collaborative, and welcoming environment where developers, security researchers, and users can learn, contribute, and build better security tools together.

Thank you for helping make **Anubis Security Tool** a respectful and security-conscious community.

**🛡️ Build responsibly. Collaborate openly. Stay secure.**
